name: Woolloongabba Medical Centre — Institutional Image Library
source: Practitioner portraits supplied by website owner; historical URLs preserved only for audit.
policy: Only human-verified authentic, rights-cleared original photography can enter the approved institutional image library. Production-use history is NOT proof of authenticity or licence.

cropStandards: 7:8 mobile crop compatible with locked homepage
hero.cropRule: Protect identifiable signage and essential clinic façade; subject remains legible beneath approved text overlay. Use only approved existing responsive sizes.
hero.styleRule: Natural local morning/afternoon light; avoid added architectural details or misleading signage.
hero.currentGap: No independently verified original provenance or raw source file supplied for existing hero imagery.

community.cropRule: Establish genuine neighbourhood context with geographic recognisability; avoid using the clinic exterior as a substitute for neighbourhood photography.
community.styleRule: Documentary local streetscape; natural Brisbane daylight, no manufactured crowds.
community.currentGap: No source-controlled local original of the currently referenced Wikimedia Gabba streetscape.

clinic-exterior.cropRule: Show factual entrance, signage, step-free routes, landmarks and access; never crop to imply parking or access not actually present.
clinic-exterior.styleRule: Truthful architectural documentary photography with moderate tonal correction.
clinic-exterior.currentGap: Existing polished exterior derivatives have no embedded primary-source provenance or signed approval records in the archive.

team.cropRule: Follow existing practitioner standard: 4:5, eye line 38–42% of frame; unchanged identity, same head scale and safe card crop.
team.styleRule: Neutral background, diffused light, natural skin tones; no face generation, swapping, restoration, reshaping or AI portrait enhancement.
team.currentGap: 11 portrait originals remain external; two team members have no verified public photograph. No authenticated group photograph provided.

services.cropRule: Show the truthful procedure, environment or equipment without implying unavailable services or real-clinic interiors.
services.styleRule: Authentic on-site patient-consented photography or clearly licensed general editorial imagery only where context is honest.
services.currentGap: No authentic locally supplied service or procedure photography verified. Existing HotDoc screenshots/posters are collateral, not genuine clinic photographs.

governance.cropRule: Show true clinical safety, processes, teams or premises with no identifiable patient documents.
governance.styleRule: Discreet process documentary imagery, not staged accreditation symbolism or false compliance claims.
governance.currentGap: No authenticated clinic governance photography provided; AGPAL marks remain governed brand assets, not governance photography.

colourGrading.intent: consistent natural Brisbane daylight; premium, factual healthcare editorial; human warmth without artificial stylisation
colourGrading.colourSpace: sRGB for production derivative; archive untouched original/master with embedded metadata
colourGrading.whiteBalance: neutral whites and natural skin tones; adjust only from reliable neutral references; no universal Kelvin preset
colourGrading.exposure: recover detail without losing realistic highlights and shadows; retain faithful sign, wall and medical equipment colours
colourGrading.saturation: restrained; no global LUT mandatory or fixed percentage applied to every photograph
colourGrading.contrast: mild to moderate, no crushed shadows or artificial halos; preserve patient-facing legibility under overlay
retouchAllowed: licence-approved anonymisation of incidental people or documents
retouchForbidden: new windows, signs, facilities, doors or equipment
changing practitioner identity or clinically material equipment
colourGrading.derivativeRule: Keep source bytes unmodified; all crops/grades require separate derivation with parentSourceSha256, recipe record and visual approval.

publicationWorkflow.notApprovedUntil: All mandatory evidence is recorded by a human reviewer; no script or existing site reference automatically upgrades an asset.

cmsReadiness.visibleImageRule: Only show approved images for NEW or REPLACED placements. If no approved image exists, omit the image block; never auto-fill with AI or unrelated clinic photos.
cmsReadiness.legacyFreeze: Existing public website imagery and DOM remain unchanged until explicitly approved for replacement; legacy artwork may not be repurposed into a new clinic.
cmsReadiness.missingPractitionerPolicy: Do not create likenesses; follow existing neutral no-photo state.
